Indonesia’s 44 GW Nuclear Ambition: Southeast Asia’s New Powerhouse 🇮🇩⚛️⚡

Indonesia has officially "gone big" on nuclear. With a newly unveiled plan to deploy 44 GW of nuclear capacity by 2060, the archipelago is positioning itself as the leader of the energy transition in Southeast Asia.

Here is the breakdown of the 🇮🇩 Indonesia Nuclear Business Roadmap:

1. The 2030s Kick-off ⏱️

Indonesia isn't waiting until the 2050s to start. The first commercial units are expected to come online by 2032–2033.
The Goal: Build a minimum of 10 GW to 15 GW by 2040 to anchor the national grid.
The Drivers: Rapid industrial growth and the urgent need to phase out aging coal-fired power plants.

2. SMRs for the Archipelago 🛰️🏝️

Indonesia’s unique geography makes it the perfect market for Small Modular Reactors (SMRs).
Remote Power: Instead of giant transmission lines across thousands of islands, Indonesia is looking at SMRs to power industrial parks and remote coastal cities.
NuScale & Beyond: Partnerships are already in motion with 🇺🇸 US and 🇰🇷 South Korean firms to pilot modular designs that can be scaled island-by-island.

3. The $100 Billion Opportunity 💰

Achieving 44 GW will require a massive influx of foreign and private capital.
✅ BAPPENAS (National Development Planning Agency): Has integrated nuclear into the "Indonesia Gold 2045" vision.
✅ Regulatory Shift: The establishment of a Nuclear Energy Program Implementing Organization (NEPIO) is the final signal to global investors that the project is "bankable."

The "Regional" Question: 👇

With Indonesia committing to 44 GW, will this trigger a Nuclear Race for Energy in Southeast Asia? 🌏

1️⃣ Vietnam 🇻🇳 (Restarting their stalled projects)

2️⃣ Philippines 🇵🇭 (Reopening the Bataan plant)

3️⃣ Thailand 🇹🇭 (Pushing for SMRs in their Power Development Plan)

Who will be the first to follow Indonesia’s lead? Drop your pick below! 🗳️
https://t.co/tnwt0NvB3i

#Indonesia #NuclearEnergy #SMR #SoutheastAsia #EnergyTransition #NetZero #Investment #Infrastructure #AseanEnergy #2026Outlook

NEWS UPDATE: April 7 Operation Roaring lion

Missile fire from Iran and Lebanon continued into the holiday evening, with launches targeting central Israel, Eilat and communities in the Galilee. 
A cluster-type missile fired toward the Dan region at midday resulted in 16 impact sites across cities including Tel Aviv, Ramat Gan and Petah Tikva, though no injuries were reported there. Earlier in the day, additional impacts were recorded from a morning barrage, while in Nahariya a woman in her 20s was lightly wounded and vehicles were damaged following rocket fire from Lebanon.

Meanwhile, hundreds gathered in Haifa to mourn the Gershovitz family—three members killed when an Iranian missile struck their home, with a fourth victim to be buried in the Philippines.

Tensions continued to escalate regionally as U.S. President Donald Trump voiced doubt over a diplomatic breakthrough with Iran, warning of severe consequences if talks fail, while Israel reportedly prepares for potential strikes on key infrastructure targets. 

Explosions were reported at Iran’s main oil export hub on Kharg Island alongside broader strikes on infrastructure and IRGC-linked sites, as Tehran warned its “restraint is over” and threatened attacks on U.S. and allied assets. Separately, a gunfight near the Israeli consulate in Istanbul left one attacker dead and two wounded after they opened fire on police, with Turkish authorities linking them to a religiously motivated group.

Alexandra Lukash

data.raw_text:
⭐ Cha Eun-woo: The Artist You Thought You Knew — But Don’t.

My quest began when I realized  
how many people stop at the surface. 🌿  

But Cha Eun-woo  
is not someone you fully understand at a glance—  
he reveals himself slowly. 💜  

And every time you look closer…  
there is more to see ✨  

⸻

🌿 The Foundation — What People Miss

Most people stop at the visuals.  

Sometimes,  
his success is viewed  
through the lens of his appearance—  

before the depth behind it  
is fully understood.  

But those who look deeper  
see the gem within 💎🤍  

People think they know him.  
They don’t—not really.  

Because the real story isn’t the face—  
it’s the discipline, the mind,  
and the way he was already building himself  
long before the spotlight arrived 🕊️  

He wasn’t just a good student—  
he was that student:

📚 consistently top of his class  
🎓 Hanlim Arts High School → Sungkyunkwan University  
👑 student leader, team captain  

The kind of person  
who didn’t need an escape—  
he had options.

doctor  
judge  
lawyer  
teacher  

— and still would’ve excelled 🌱  

⸻

🌸 The Name Before the Spotlight

Before the world knew “Cha Eun-woo,”  
there was Lee Dong-min 🤍  

One shines in presence,  
the other in quiet strength.  

Not separate—  
but perfectly balanced.  

⸻

🌟 The Name That Became Reality

Even his names carry truths  
that match the life he built.  

Lee Dong-min —  
steadiness, sincerity,  
a person shaped from the inside out.  

Cha Eun-woo —  
clarity, light,  
someone meant to be seen  
but never defined by being seen.  

Two names,  
one foundation:  
a man whose reality rose  
to meet the meaning.  

⸻

🌏 The Choice

He didn’t enter out of necessity.  
He was scouted—  
and at first, he said no.  

Because this wasn’t rushed.  
It was considered.  

🕊️  
He chose this path—  
and then he built it.  

⸻

🌙 The Growth

At a young age, he lived briefly in the Philippines  
to improve his English. 🌏  

Now multilingual—  
Korean, English, with basic Mandarin & Japanese.  

But his growth wasn’t just academic or linguistic.  
It was artistic.  
Layered.  
Deliberate.  

He trained early—  
🎤 singing  
🎬 acting  
🎹 piano  
🎧 performance and more  

Not talent by accident,  
but skill by intention.  

He didn’t wait for opportunities—  
he prepared for them.  

He keeps learning—  
languages, music, expression—  

not for display,  
but for growth 🌙  

⸻

🧭 The Strategy

No noise.  
No need to prove.  

Just discipline—  
repeated quietly  
until it becomes undeniable.  

He builds himself—  
step by step,  
choice by choice.  

⸻

✨ The Truth

He looks effortless.  
But nothing is accidental.  

🕊️  
If anyone thinks he can be replaced—  
think again.  

He never relied on his extraordinary visuals.  
He built on what lasts—  
the depth of his talent,  
the steadiness of his character,  
the effort layered quietly over years  
until ability became artistry. 🌿  

With humility.  
With sincerity.  
With quiet respect.  

He may seem effortless,  
but the long hours are there.  
The quiet excellence is there.  
The work stitched into every moment  
is what makes the ease possible. 🤍  

And in that stillness,  
a truth forms—  
soft, undeniable,  
and felt before it’s understood:  

Cha Eun-woo is irreplaceable.  
Cha Eun-woo is unstoppable. ✌🏻  

⸻

🌐 The Influence

47.1 million follow him—  
not for chaos,  
but quiet excellence.  

Across cultures,  
across ages,  
across languages—  

his presence translates  
without needing to be explained.  

⸻

🌾 The Groundedness

Through it all—  
he remains grounded.  

Quiet.  
Measured.  
Focused.  

A man who knows who he is—  
and who he chooses to be.  

⸻

✨ A Tribute Beyond a Date

Not just for a day—  
but for the man he continues to become.  

⸻

🕊️ The Part That Stays

That’s the part people don’t always see—  
and the part that stays 🤍  

Small moments. Big hearts. 🤍  
#ChaEunWoo 
#차은우 
#ASTRO 
@CHAEUNWOO_offcl

My quest began when I realized how many people stop at the surface. 🌿 But Cha Eun-woo is not someone you fully understand at a glance— he reveals himself slowly. 💜 And every time you look closer… there is more to see ✨ ⸻ 🌿 The Foundation — What People Miss Most people stop at the visuals. Sometimes, his success is viewed through the lens of his appearance— before the depth behind it is fully understood. But those who look deeper see the gem within 💎🤍 People think they know him. They don’t—not really. Because the real story isn’t the face— it’s the discipline, the mind, and the way he was already building himself long before the spotlight arrived 🕊️ He wasn’t just a good student— he was that student: 📚 consistently top of his class 🎓 Hanlim Arts High School → Sungkyunkwan University 👑 student leader, team captain The kind of person who didn’t need an escape— he had options. doctor judge lawyer teacher — and still would’ve excelled 🌱 ⸻ 🌸 The Name Before the Spotlight Before the world knew “Cha Eun-woo,” there was Lee Dong-min 🤍 One shines in presence, the other in quiet strength. Not separate— but perfectly balanced. ⸻ 🌟 The Name That Became Reality Even his names carry truths that match the life he built. Lee Dong-min — steadiness, sincerity, a person shaped from the inside out. Cha Eun-woo — clarity, light, someone meant to be seen but never defined by being seen. Two names, one foundation: a man whose reality rose to meet the meaning. ⸻ 🌏 The Choice He didn’t enter out of necessity. He was scouted— and at first, he said no. Because this wasn’t rushed. It was considered. 🕊️ He chose this path— and then he built it. ⸻ 🌙 The Growth At a young age, he lived briefly in the Philippines to improve his English. 🌏 Now multilingual— Korean, English, with basic Mandarin & Japanese. But his growth wasn’t just academic or linguistic. It was artistic. Layered. Deliberate. He trained early— 🎤 singing 🎬 acting 🎹 piano 🎧 performance and more Not talent by accident, but skill by intention. He didn’t wait for opportunities— he prepared for them. He keeps learning— languages, music, expression— not for display, but for growth 🌙 ⸻ 🧭 The Strategy No noise. No need to prove. Just discipline— repeated quietly until it becomes undeniable. He builds himself— step by step, choice by choice. ⸻ ✨ The Truth He looks effortless. But nothing is accidental. 🕊️ If anyone thinks he can be replaced— think again. He never relied on his extraordinary visuals. He built on what lasts— the depth of his talent, the steadiness of his character, the effort layered quietly over years until ability became artistry. 🌿 With humility. With sincerity. With quiet respect. He may seem effortless, but the long hours are there. The quiet excellence is there. The work stitched into every moment is what makes the ease possible. 🤍 And in that stillness, a truth forms— soft, undeniable, and felt before it’s understood: Cha Eun-woo is irreplaceable. Cha Eun-woo is unstoppable. ✌🏻 ⸻ 🌐 The Influence 47.1 million follow him— not for chaos, but quiet excellence. Across cultures, across ages, across languages— his presence translates without needing to be explained. ⸻ 🌾 The Groundedness Through it all— he remains grounded. Quiet. Measured. Focused. A man who knows who he is— and who he chooses to be. ⸻ ✨ A Tribute Beyond a Date Not just for a day— but for the man he continues to become. ⸻ 🕊️ The Part That Stays That’s the part people don’t always see— and the part that stays 🤍 Small moments. Big hearts. 🤍 #ChaEunWoo #차은우 #ASTRO
